title: Pouding chomeur
hookLine: Canadian-inspired pouding chomeur with 11 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Pouding chomeur
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large bowl, with an electric mixer, mix the butter and sugar till the mix is light. Add eggs and vanilla and mix. In another bowl, mix flour and baking powder. Incorporate {m52932_1}, {m52932_2}, {m52932_3}, and {m52932_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Alternate flour mix and milk to the butter mix. Pour into a 13 inch by 9 inch greased pan. In a large casserole, bring to boil the syrup, brown sugar, cream and butter and constantly stir. Incorporate {m52932_5}, {m52932_6}, {m52932_7}, {m52932_8}, {m52932_9}, {m52932_10}, and {m52932_11} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Pouding chomeur & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Reduce heat and and gently cook 2 minutes or till sauce has reduced a little bit. Pour sauce gently over cake. Bake at 325°f (160°c) about 35 minutes or till cake is light brown and when toothpick inserted comes out clean.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
